patent.title: Stable pharmaceutical solution formulations for pressurised metered dose inhalers
patent.family_note: Holdout INT-15. UK SPC/GB11/051 basic patent for Fostair/Formodual. Do not conflate with sibling device/process patents on same product.

knowledge_origin.description: Chiesi Farmaceutici assignee; pharmaceutical formulation RD.

technology.problem: Chemical instability of phenylalkylamino β2-agonists (e.g. formoterol) in HFA solution pMDI vehicles relative to CFC formulations.
technology.mechanism: HFA solution aerosol of formoterol (or salt) combined with a steroid (e.g. BDP), apparent pH adjusted to 2.5–5.0 with mineral acid; optional low-volatility component / inert-coated can.
technology.comparison_baseline: Prior CFC solution / unstable HFA solutions without pH control (patent background).

value_carriers.name: Fostair® / Formodual® (beclometasone dipropionate + formoterol fumarate dihydrate) pMDI solution
value_carriers.description: UK SPC/GB11/051 lists EP(UK)1787639 as basic patent for Fostair/Formodual. SmPC API pair matches claim 1/11 combination class; full pH/ethanol bands not on label → strong_evidence not fully confirmed.

value_links.note: Regulatory SPC basic-patent listing + composition match.

gaps.description: No public E4 attributing revenue specifically to this formulation patent vs sibling patents; SPC exclusivity expired before T0.
Full quantitative ethanol/acid/pH recipe matching claim 11 not on SmPC.

notes: Holdout INT-15. T0=2026-10-13. UK SPC basic patent + claims PASS (strong) → R3; NO auto R4/R5 / NO E4. SPC expired by T0 — map still counts. Formal V0.7; not V0.8.
